test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'leading'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word 'leading' suggests a direct cause and effect - mankind's actions are leading to (or causing) the breakdown of the life-supporting systems on Earth.
 
• The term 'leading' highlights the active role humans play in causing environmental damage, hence it is the most apt description of the situation.
 
• 'Leading' keeps the responsibility with humanity, stressing our role in the resulting ecological disturbance.
 
• This term gives an urgency to the situation, drawing attention to humanity's contribution to this ecological crisis.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• 'Managing', 'dealing', and 'creating' don't convey the cause-and-effect relationship between human actions and the ecological imbalance as accurately as 'leading' does.
